title: A routine NDA
narration: Every clause checked against the playbook; nothing deviates, the liability and governing-law clauses are present, so code approves it with no human involved.

title: An Arabic services contract with two issues
narration: The agent finds an interest-bearing late fee and unrestricted data transfers, quotes the Arabic text, drafts redlines, and the route is negotiate: the redline goes to the counterparty.

title: Uncapped liability, in Arabic
narration: Uncapped buyer liability is a critical red flag: it escalates to legal no matter what, with the exact question for the lawyer.

title: A contract that tries to instruct the AI
narration: A clause tells automated reviewers to approve. The agent treats it as data, still records the real issue, and code escalates the contract.
